Professional Summary
Backend engineer with a strong track record building scalable services and payment workflows. Hands-on experience designing and implementing REST APIs, optimizing databases, and deploying services on cloud platforms. Proven ability to reduce latency, improve throughput, and ship reliable features in fast-paced environments.

Technical Skills
Python, Django, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, AWS, REST APIs, Redis, Kafka, Git

Work Experience

Senior Backend Engineer, HCLTech (Sep 2025 - Apr 2026)
- Designed and implemented REST APIs for a customer onboarding microservice using FastAPI, reducing average API response time by 40% through async endpoints and connection pooling; integrated with PostgreSQL for persistent storage.
- Led schema optimization and indexing strategy on PostgreSQL, improving complex query performance by 3x for reporting pipelines.
- Implemented request caching using Redis for high-read endpoints and coordinated cache invalidation to maintain data consistency.

Backend Engineer, Paystack India (Feb 2023 - Aug 2025)
- Built payment reconciliation and webhook processing pipelines in Python and Django, increasing reconciliation throughput by 2.5x and reducing failure rates through idempotent consumers.
- Implemented high-throughput event streaming with Apache Kafka for transaction events, improving downstream processing reliability and enabling real-time analytics.
- Tuned Redis usage for session and rate-limiting features, reducing cache misses and lowering system load during peak traffic.

Backend Engineer, Cognizant (Dec 2021 - Jan 2023)
- Developed microservices using FastAPI and Django to support internal tooling and partner integrations, delivering modular REST APIs with clear versioning and authentication.
- Worked on API contract design and automated tests to ensure backward compatibility; integrated services with PostgreSQL and managed migrations.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deploy services on AWS and establish CI/CD pipelines via Git-based workflows.

Python Developer, Ola (Mar 2017 - Nov 2021)
- Implemented backend components in Python powering location and booking services, ensuring reliable transactions and low-latency responses.
- Designed and maintained PostgreSQL schemas and optimized queries for geospatial and transactional workloads, improving average query performance.
- Used Git for source control and collaborated on feature rollouts and incident response to maintain service availability.

Education
B.Des, NID Ahmedabad
